# Figures for BLL fiscal 2012

- **Ball Corporation (12/31/2012):** $191.01 (from the 10-K)
- **S&P 500 (12/31/2012):** $89.36 (from the 10-K)
- **S&P 500 (12/31/2008):** $56.59 (from the 10-K)
- **S&P 500 (12/31/2011):** $78.80 (from the 10-K)

## Five Year Total Return Calculation

### Ball Corporation
- Initial value (12/31/2007): $100.00
- Final value (12/31/2012): $191.01
- Total return: 
  \[ \frac{191.01 - 100.00}{100.00} \times 100 = 91.01\% \]

### DJ US Containers & Packaging Index
- Initial value (12/31/2007): $100.00
- Final value (12/31/2012): $107.76
- Total return: 
  \[ \frac{107.76 - 100.00}{100.00} \times 100 = 7.76\% \]

### Difference in Total Return
- Difference: 
  \[ 91.01\% - 7.76\% = 83.25\% \]

The five year total return for the period ending 12/31/2012 on Ball Corporation stock was 83.25% greater than the same return on the DJ US Containers & Packaging Index.

**Source:** 10-K annual report, page 31.
